strategy_roster.name: Simple 2 MA I
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema((high + low + close) / 3, 6) > ema((high + low + close) / 3, 85) and roc(close, 14) > 0.3 and macd(close, 12, 26) > macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9)
strategy_roster.exit_long: crossbelow(ema((high + low + close) / 3, 6), ema((high + low + close) / 3, 85)) or roc(close, 14) < -0.3 or crossbelow(macd(close, 12, 26), macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9))
strategy_roster.notes: Documented LWMA(6)/LWMA(85) on typical price are approximated by EMAs, with the documented ROC(14) threshold 0.3 and MACD 12/26/9 direction filter kept. Stops, targets, break-even and candle trailing are documented in raw points, not percentages, so they are left null.

strategy_roster.name: Blau TVI Timed Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: TVI is 100*(Up-Down)/(Up+Down) where Up/Down derive from (volume +/- close-open)/2, so its sign and slope are the smoothed (close-open); a doubly smoothed ROC proxy captures the documented two-bar rising/falling slope reversal. The three smoothing lengths have no documented values (8 used), and the session window plus point-based stops are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Stochastic RSI Cross
strategy_roster.notes: StochRSI %K/%D are approximated by RSI(14) and its SMA(3) with a near-oversold filter, using the documented RsiPeriod 14 / KPeriod 3. The documented StopLossPercent of 2 is applied; no take-profit value is documented.

strategy_roster.name: AMA Trader 2
strategy_roster.notes: The Kaufman AMA trend filter is approximated by EMA(10); the long rule keeps the documented close-above-AMA plus an RSI oversold dip. RsiLength, AmaLength and RsiLevelDown have no documented values (14, 10 and 40 used), and fixed-lot averaging, position counts, trailing stops and the time window cannot be expressed.

strategy_roster.name: PSAR Trader v2
strategy_roster.notes: Parabolic SAR is not in the DSL, so the SAR flip is approximated by price holding above EMA(10) while making a fresh five-bar high (mirrored on exit). The StartHour/EndHour window and price-unit stop/target are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: TakeProfitTimeGuardStrategy
strategy_roster.notes: The documentation states the strategy never opens positions and only flattens exposure when the account profit target or schedule is met, so there is no single-symbol market-derived entry to translate. A never-true guard is used instead of inventing a signal; the profit target and time window are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Polynomial Regression Bands Channel
strategy_roster.notes: The degree-2 regression line and its residual bands are approximated by SMA(100) and 2 standard deviations, keeping the documented Length 100 and multiplier 2. Docs state no stops, and the opposite-signal exit is represented by the regression line.

strategy_roster.name: Streak-Based Trading
strategy_roster.notes: A long entry follows the documented 8-candle losing streak (eight consecutive bearish candles with the documented TradeDirection=Long), and the exit fires after the documented 7-candle hold. Doji body filtering has no DSL equivalent and the intraday timeframe is not modelled.

strategy_roster.name: Market EKG
strategy_roster.notes: The documented rule buys when the average of the two older closes exceeds the latest close; SMA(3) of the close is the available rolling proxy for that two-bar average. No parameters, exits or stops beyond the mirrored comparison are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Lunar Calendar Day Crypto Trading
strategy_roster.notes: Entries are keyed to the 12th day of a lunar month and exits to the 26th, which is a calendar feature with no market-derived signal in the DSL. A never-true guard prevents fabricating one; the preloaded lunar tables are not accessible here.
